subject: physiology
title: WBCs, phagocytosis and innate immunity

steps.tx: **Leukocytes** count neutrophils near sixty percent first to phagocytose, lymphocytes near thirty percent adapting, monocytes becoming macrophages, eosinophils fighting parasites and allergy, and basophils carrying heparin and histamine, marginating by selectins, squeezing by diapedesis, and chasing by chemotaxis to C5a and interleukin eight. Left shift bands mark sepsis, leukemoid counts near fifty thousand raise LAP against leukaemia, leukopenia follows typhoid and viruses, and steroids demarginate counts upward. Margins therefore roll before cells migrate into tissues to defend the host daily.
steps.say: Neutrophils dominate near sixty percent as first responders, lymphocytes near thirty percent adapt, monocytes mature into macrophages, eosinophils attack parasites and allergy, and basophils store histamine, the order remembered in the cell table. Cells marginate, squeeze through walls and follow chemotactic signals to infection. Band left shift marks acute sepsis, steroids falsely raise counts by demargination, and typhoid characteristically lowers the white count.

vis.alt: Table of white cell types with typical share and role: neutrophils about 60 percent for first response, lymphocytes about 30 percent adaptive immunity, monocytes becoming macrophages, eosinophils for parasites and allergy, basophils with histamine and heparin.
vis.caption: Never Let Monkeys Eat Bananas: neutrophil, lymphocyte, monocyte, eosinophil, basophil in descending order of abundance.

steps.tx: **Phagocytosis** coats microbes with opsonins C3b and IgG, engulfs by pseudopods into a phagosome fusing lysosomes, bursts oxidatively by NADPH making hypochlorous acid, greens pus by myeloperoxidase, and kills by defensin peptides. Defects fail characteristically: chronic granulomatous disease nitroblue negative lacking oxidase, Chediak Higashi giant granules with albinism, Job syndrome eczema with high IgE and retained teeth, and leukocyte adhesion deficiency delaying cord separation, while pus collects dead neutrophils. Coats therefore engulf before bleach kills invaders.
steps.say: Opsonins tag microbes for eating: pseudopods engulf them, lysosomes fuse, and NADPH oxidase with myeloperoxidase brews bleach inside the phagosome, the sequence in the phagocytosis figure whose caption names the failing enzyme. Each broken step gives a syndrome, oxidase loss in chronic granulomatous disease, giant granules with albinism, high IgE with retained teeth, and late cord separation when adhesion fails. Pus is the graveyard of spent neutrophils.

vis.alt: Steps of phagocytosis: chemotaxis and margination, opsonisation by C3b and IgG, engulfment into a phagosome, fusion with lysosome, oxidative burst by NADPH oxidase with myeloperoxidase making hypochlorous acid; chronic granulomatous disease lacks NADPH oxidase.
vis.caption: NADPH oxidase makes superoxide; myeloperoxidase makes bleach. CGD lacks the first enzyme and fails the NBT or DHR test.

steps.tx: **Complement** activates classically by C1 on antibody, alternatively by spontaneous C3b on microbes, and by lectin on mannose, lysing by membrane attack complex C5b to nine, recruiting by anaphylatoxins C3a and C5a, and swelling airways when C1 esterase inhibitor fails as angioedema. Deficiency links C2 to lupus, terminal five to nine loss to neisserial infection, and inhibitor loss to danazol responsive swelling, opsonising by C3b while C reactive protein marks pneumococcal acute phase. Cascades therefore punch holes while eculizumab blocks terminally after meningococcal vaccination.
steps.say: Three entrances converge on C3: antibody starts the classical route, microbial surfaces start the alternative route, and mannose binding lectin starts the lectin route, drawn together in the complement figure. C3b is coating microbes for phagocytosis, C3a and C5a are recruiting inflammation, and C5b to nine is punching the membrane attack hole. Missing early parts invite lupus, missing terminal parts invite Neisseria, and missing inhibitor swells the airway.

vis.alt: Complement activation: classical pathway by C1 on antibody, alternative pathway by spontaneous C3b on microbes, lectin pathway by mannose binding lectin, all forming C3 convertase and then C5 convertase; C3b opsonises, C3a and C5a recruit cells, C5b to C9 form the membrane attack complex.
vis.caption: Three entry pathways, one common result: opsonisation (C3b), inflammation (C3a, C5a), lysis (MAC C5b-9).

steps.tx: Acute **inflammation** reddens, swells, heats and pains as rubor, tumor, calor and dolor: histamine dilates vessels, prostaglandins fever, bradykinin pains, nonsteroidal drugs block cyclo oxygenase, and steroids block phospholipase upstream. Fever resets by interleukin one at the hypothalamus, rigors spike with bacteraemia, antipyretics comfort rather than cure, and resolution by lipoxins drains pus or walls tuberculosis into granulomas to heal, while chronic macrophage giant cell inflammation persists. Heats therefore swell until lipoxins resolve or granulomas contain.
steps.say: Redness, swelling, heat and pain follow histamine vasodilation, prostaglandin fever and bradykinin pain, mediators that nonsteroidal drugs and steroids interrupt at different depths. Interleukin one is resetting the hypothalamic thermostat, rigors are accompanying bloodstream invasion, and antipyretics only comfort. Resolution needs lipoxins, drained pus or a granuloma wall around tuberculosis, summarised in the table, while macrophage driven chronic inflammation refuses to switch off.
